item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00414","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C01","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.71,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C23 plausibly supplied a material veto-memorandum template. Both memoranda open by withholding approval of a named bill, explain the bill through the prior statutory program it would alter, acknowledge the sympathetic interests of the favored beneficiaries, identify a governing principle that the bill would abandon, analyze inequities between similarly situated groups, and reject the measure in favor of preserving the existing coherent statutory scheme. C01 has a related principle-and-equity veto structure, while C24 similarly contrasts an ostensible purpose with harmful practical effects, but neither matches the child's full sequence as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have withheld my approval from H.R. 3419... The purpose of the Merchant Ship Sales Act was to establish a uniform pricing policy...","parent_excerpt":"I HAVE withheld my approval of S. 2115... The purpose of the enactment is to authorize the payment...","explanation":"Both begin with the same veto formulation and immediately explain the proposed amendment against the purpose and operation of the existing statutory program."},{"child_excerpt":"The fundamental question presented by this bill is which of the two interpretations... results in the more equitable treatment to all parties concerned.","parent_excerpt":"It seems obvious that inequities are bound to arise when specific gifts are made without references to a distinctive need...","explanation":"Each centers the disapproval analysis on equitable treatment among beneficiaries rather than merely on cost or authority."},{"child_excerpt":"The consistent pattern of treatment provided in the Act would be destroyed by granting in this one subsection the concession...","parent_excerpt":"S. 2115 would abandon the principle upon which the original program was based... The step-by-step distribution of such gifts to wider and wider groups... would destroy the delicately balanced disability compensation structure...","explanation":"The memoranda use substantially parallel machinery: identify the prior program's organizing principle, show how a targeted amendment would disrupt its coherent structure, and reject the special concession."},{"child_excerpt":"I believe, therefore, that the owners... should request the Secretary of Commerce to examine the possibility of relieving them... If it is determined that no authority exists... the Congress should be requested to enact legislation...","parent_excerpt":"When we move beyond... the sound and equitable method of meeting the needs... is through the provision of a carefully considered scale of compensation...","explanation":"Both conclude the substantive analysis by pointing toward relief through the established or a more carefully tailored mechanism instead of approving the pending bill."}]}
